title: Ambush Bug Stocking Stuffer #1 DC 1986 Keith Giffen Christmas Cheeks Toy Wonder
condition_description: Bright, clean covers with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Ambush Bug Stocking Stuffer #1 (February 1986), DC Comics Christmas one-shot - the return of Cheeks the Toy Wonder. By Keith Giffen and Robert Loren Fleming; cover by Giffen and Bob Oksner. DC 50th anniversary logo. $1.25 cover price.

Back cover: Voltron Force / Panosh Place ad.

Condition: bright, clean covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
